about: Sudoku representation and search mutants. Killers name Ergo laws/tests, run with ergo test, not Go packages.

mutants.name: v2-highest-digit-first
mutants.rule: FirstChoiceIsLowest observes the search order on generated grids with digits 1 and 9 erased; validity and deterministic repeated solves do not distinguish the order.

mutants.name: v2-highest-tied-cell-first
mutants.rule: FirstChoiceIsLowest requires the lowest tied cell, not only the lowest candidate digit.

mutants.name: v2-missing-ninth-bit
mutants.rule: Existing SolvesHardPuzzles needs digit 9 and kills a truncated candidate mask.

mutants.name: v2-reuse-failed-branch
mutants.rule: Existing SolvesHardPuzzles needs a fresh value snapshot on retry after a contradiction.
